decisions.reason: The MMAK modular concept has a documented customer success of more than 600,000 euros saved per year and overlaps with the flagship line, so it stays as part of the firm's strategic direction.
The mobile slow-speed shredder is core to the firm's established offer and has kept its own page across both years, so it remains on the market.
This is the flagship modular processing line with a quantified customer reference, central to the firm's direction and after-sales growth.
The 2024 multi-model shredder line is a recent core offering with its own page and fits the firm's push toward newer machine generations.
The new spiral shaft screen line extends the screening portfolio, which may also replace the dropped trommel, and is too new to withdraw.
